summary.en-US: Offline AI support for children with ASD

description.en-US:
AYNI (reciprocity in Quechua) is a fully offline Android tablet app that gives
behavioral support to children with autism spectrum disorder, plus a
psychoeducational guide for parents and educators.

Everything runs on the device. No internet, no cloud, no child data ever
leaving the tablet.

* Four calm, predictable mini-games designed with the TEACCH method
* A parent and educator Q&A grounded in a clinician-authored knowledge base
* A therapist panel with anonymized, opt-in engagement data

Built for therapy centers in low-connectivity communities in Peru. A project
of the WIE Student Branch at Universidad Tecnologica del Peru, funded by
EPICS in IEEE.
